newsitem.title: UK: Next rises on upbeat comments.
newsitem.headline: Next rises on upbeat comments.

text.p: Shares in Next Plc were up on Wednesday, lifted by upbeat comments from the UK retailer, dealers said.
Next held a lunch meeting with analysts yesterday and brokerage SBC Warburg subsequently repeated an "add" recommendation, also contributing to the advance in the share price, dealers said.
By 0944 GMT, the shares were up 8-1/2p to 558-1/2p.

Analyst Nick Bubb of MeesPierson attended yesterday's meeting. He said Next noted that clothing price inflation was picking up, and that sales of its autumn line, particularly in the women's division, have been strong since mid-August.
